provenance.source: heygen-com/experiment-framework PR #55249 (transcription accepts API keys) and its stack; live canary calls through the HyperFrames Desktop key proxy on 2026-10-07
provenance.kind: PR-and-live-call-derived structural contract; route hidden from public docs
notes: Synchronous: transcription runs inside the POST; GET /v3/audio/transcriptions/{id} re-reads it.
Idempotency-Key is required (400 without it); a replay of the same key and body returns the same job without a new charge.
Auth: x-api-key (OAuth tokens get 403 api_key_required) with assets:write (create) / assets:read (read); 403 insufficient_api_key_scope otherwise. Charged to HeyGen API credits.
Response data: id, status, model, created_at, language, duration_seconds, text, segments[{speaker?, start, end, text, words[{word, start, end, speaker?}]}]. speaker appears when diarize is true.
Only the fields below were exercised; add others only after checking the current backend DTO.

With a Desktop-managed profile, the local proxy treats scribe-v2 as the compatible transcription operation and chooses HeyGen ASR for an internal API-key owner when its existing backend access gate allows it. A disabled-endpoint 404 selects Scribe v2 before inference; other inference failures do not switch providers.

Read the returned model/engine and the job record model_actual to identify what ran. Direct HeyGen API calls retain the native Scribe contract. URL inputs and audio outside the ASR conversion limits stay on Scribe.

language.description: ISO 639-1 or 639-3 code of the spoken language; left out, the language is detected
